atoms.b: Wales shares borders with all parts of England: South, Midlands, and North. The capital city of Wales is ((++Cardiff Edinburgh London)).
Cardiff is not only the ((++largest tallest)) but also the ((++capital master)) city of Wales. A lot of British TV shows and films are produced there.

Wales is a country of two languages. The people who live in Wales speak English, but around 20% of them also speak ((++Welsh Scottish Irish)). To preserve the language, kids learn the language in school and words on ((++street_signs cars animals)) are written in both languages.

instruction.text: Lies den Text und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.text: There are many mountains in Wales. That's why most people live only in a small part of the country. The South-East is the most populated. Because of all the mountains in the country, it's very difficult to travel between the northern and southern part of Wales. The “Snowdonia National Park” is located in the north-west of Wales. “Snowdon” is the name of the tallest mountain there. It is 1085m tall.

atoms.a: Why is it so difficult to travel through Wales?
b: There are a lot of rivers.

instruction.text: Olivia, die aus Nordirland kommt, macht gerade Urlaub in Wales. Sie schreibt ihrer Freundin Grace einen Brief. </br>Ziehe die Wörter in die passenden Lücken, um den Brief zu vervollständigen.
instruction.sound: Olivia, die aus Nordirland kommt, macht gerade Urlaub in Wales. Sie schreibt ihrer Freundin Grace einen Brief. Ziehe die Wörter in die passenden Lücken, um den Brief zu vervollständigen.

trainers.finishSound: Dear Grace, I'm currently travelling in Wales. A lot of people here speak Welsh... it's so hard to understand! Luckily, they speak English as well. Tomorrow, I want to go hiking. I'll send you a postcard from Snowdonia National Park. Snowdon is about 200m taller than our Slieve Donard. I'm so excited. See you soon! Love, Olivia.
